subject: Request: Control crosswalk & evidence plan for AlphaRise RFP
messages:
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@alpharise.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@alpharise.com>, procurement@alpharise.com
Date: 2027-11-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: RFP: Security questionnaire and SIG mapping request

Hi Jonas,

Thanks for taking this on. AlphaRise is running an accelerated RFP and we need a control-level crosswalk mapped against the SIG questionnaire we attached, plus the supporting evidence (SOC 2 report, network diagram, and any relevant policy excerpts). Primary deadline for the initial mapping is Nov 24, final packet by Nov 30.

Can Redwood confirm you can deliver: a) a filled SIG workbook (we attached v1), b) a SOC 2 summary and report PDF, and c) system/network diagrams and ownership contacts? Also let us know if you need temporary access to any artifacts.

[Attachment: AlphaRise_RFP_Security_Questionnaire_v1.docx]

Best,
Elena Morales
Sr. Procurement Manager | AlphaRise
Elena.Morales@alpharise.com
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@alpharise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Security questionnaire and SIG mapping request

Elena — thanks, we can support this. Quick clarifying Qs before we commit to the dates:

1) Scope: do you want a SIG-to-SOC2 crosswalk (mapping each SIG control to our SOC 2 control/artefact) or a per-question narrative response? We can do both but it affects turnaround.
2) Evidence delivery: is a consolidated Drive folder sufficient, or do you require sealed artifact uploads (e.g., to your portal)?
3) Redactions: do you accept redacted artifacts for things like IP addresses and user lists?

Attached is our evidence-index template (xlsx) — if you confirm scope we’ll start filling it. We’ll nominate owners: Marissa will lead the SOC2/controls mapping, Karthik will own infra/network artifacts.

Proposed milestones: initial crosswalk by 2027-11-17, complete artifact bundle by 2027-11-24, final packet by 2027-11-30. If you prefer the Nov 24 initial date from your note, we can accelerate.

[Attachment: redwood-evidence-index-template.xlsx]

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
Head of Assurance Enablement | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@alpharise.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Fischer <tom.fischer@alpharise.com>, procurement@alpharise.com
Date: 2027-11-10T11:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: RFP: Security questionnaire and SIG mapping request

Jonas — thanks for the quick reply. Scope guidance: we need a SIG-to-SOC2 control crosswalk (worksheet row per SIG control, mapped to control owner and SOC 2 criteria where applicable) plus a short narrative for any SIG controls that are out-of-scope and the compensating controls. Drive folder is fine for artifacts; we prefer redacted copies for any sensitive fields.

Please include your latest SOC 2 report PDF and a labelled network diagram (high level only). Procurement would like the initial crosswalk by Nov 17 if possible, otherwise Nov 24 latest.

One more item: we need a single point of contact for ongoing clarifying Qs — can you confirm who from Redwood will be the contact?

Elena
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-11T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: RFP: SIG mapping for AlphaRise — owners and plan

Marissa/Karthik — forwarding AlphaRise scope. They want SIG->SOC2 crosswalk plus artifacts and the initial crosswalk by Nov 17. Karthik, please pull the latest network diagram and inventory; Marissa, lead the control mapping and SOC2 doc prep. I’ll be the primary POC to AlphaRise for any clarifying Qs.

Key asks:
- Use the redwood-evidence-index-template.xlsx to collect artefacts.
- Tag each entry with: control id, owner, artifact filename, redaction flag, short description.
- For out-of-scope SIG items, include a compensating control note.

I’ll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow morning if helpful.

Jonas
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-11-12T09:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: RFP: SIG mapping for AlphaRise — owners and plan

Got it — I’ve drafted a delivery plan and started populating the template for the core SIG areas (access mgmt, change control, incident mgmt). Proposed internal timeline:
- 2027-11-14: Complete mapping for high-risk controls (access, encryption, key mgmt)
- 2027-11-17: Share initial SIG workbook (alpha) with AlphaRise
- 2027-11-24: Submit full artifact bundle (redacted PDFs + index)
- 2027-11-30: Finalize packet and close comments

Two quick notes:
1) Network diagram needs a small redaction on internal hostnames — Karthik can prepare a labelled but high-level diagram.
2) We should attach a short cover memo explaining the redaction approach for procurement.

Attaching the artifact pipeline playbook for reference.

[Attachment: artifact-pipeline-playbook.pdf]

Marissa
Director, Assurance Operations | Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <elena.morales@alpharise.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@alpharise.com
Date: 2027-11-13T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: SIG crosswalk & evidence folder: AlphaRise RFP (drive link)

Elena — per our plan, we’ve created a shared Drive folder with the initial deliverables: the SIG workbook (AlphaRise_SIG_20271110.xlsx), redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf (redacted front matter), and a labelled network diagram (network-diagram.pdf). We’ve also attached the evidence index template populated with file pointers and redaction flags.

Drive (view only): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCDEFgHIjklmnopqRSTUV

Attached files in the folder: AlphaRise_SIG_20271110.xlsx, redwood-soc2-report-2026.pdf, network-diagram.pdf, redwood-evidence-index-template-populated.xlsx

Notes:
- We redacted internal hostnames and service account emails; redactions are documented in the index.
- If you need encrypted transfer instead of Drive, let us know and we’ll arrange SFTP or your portal upload.

We’re standing by for clarifying questions and can hop on a 15-min call if needed.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Principal Systems Architect | Redwood Inference
[karthik_iyer@redwood.com]
From: Elena Morales <elena.morales@alpharise.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@alpharise.com
Date: 2027-11-13T16:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: SIG crosswalk & evidence folder: AlphaRise RFP (drive link)

Karthik — thanks, this looks good. We confirm receipt of the Drive folder and initial workbook. Elena (procurement) and Tom (security) will review the alpha workbook and come back with a consolidated list of follow-ups.

Can we schedule a short call on Nov 15 at 10:00am PT to walk through the high-risk control mappings? If that works for you please send a calendar invite.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

Best,
Elena
